units.source_text: 源氏大将进宫，先去参见皇上。

en.t: General Genji entered the palace and first went to pay his respects to the Emperor.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝此时正空闲无事，便和他共话今昔沧桑。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku happened to be free at the time, so he spoke with him about the changes of past and present.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝的相貌非常肖似桐壶院，而比他稍稍艳丽，神情优雅而温和。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku's features closely resembled those of the Kiritsubo Emperor, though he was slightly more radiant, with an elegant and gentle expression.

units.source_text: 两人相对，共诉丧父之恸。

en.t: The two men sat facing each other and shared their grief over the loss of their father.

units.source_text: 源氏大将与尚侍胧月夜的关系尚未断绝的消息，

en.t: The report that General Genji's relationship with the Naishi no Kami Oborozukiyo had not yet ended

units.source_text: 朱雀帝也曾闻知，并且有时从胧月夜举止之间也看得出来。

en.t: had also reached Emperor Suzaku, and at times he could see it in Oborozukiyo's behavior.

units.source_text: 但他想道：“此事有何不可！

en.t: But he thought, "What is wrong with this?

units.source_text: 倘是尚侍入宫后开始的，确是不成体统。

en.t: If it had begun after she entered palace service as Naishi no Kami, it would indeed be improper.

units.source_text: 但他们是早有关系的，那么互相心交，并无不称之处。”

en.t: But since they had been involved from long before, there is nothing unsuitable about their continuing to care for each other."

units.source_text: 因此并不责备源氏大将。

en.t: For that reason, he did not blame General Genji.
The two of them talked about many things.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝将学问上的疑义请源氏大将讲解，又谈论恋爱的诗歌，

en.t: Emperor Suzaku asked General Genji to explain points of scholarship that puzzled him, and they also discussed poems of love,

units.source_text: 顺便说到六条妃子的女儿斋宫赴伊势那天的事，赞叹斋宫容貌之美丽。

en.t: then in passing spoke of the day when the Saigu, daughter of the Rokujo lady, departed for Ise, and praised the beauty of the Saigu's appearance.

units.source_text: 源氏大将也毫无顾忌，叙述那天在野宫访晤六条妃子时黎明的情景。

en.t: General Genji, without any reserve, described the dawn scene that day when he visited the Rokujo lady at the fields of Nonomiya.
